questions.question: Why does the growth rate decline in the stationary phase?
questions.solution_html:
• Why does the growth rate decline in the stationary phase? / [CO3]
  • Growth rate slows as cells enter stationary phase, nutrients become limited and metabolic
  • end products/waste products accumulate. The rate of cell inhibition or death balances out
  • the rate of multiplication The number of cells growing will equal the amount of cells dying
  • (2).

questions.question: List the characteristics of Stationary phase. [2x10 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• List the characteristics of stationary phase. / [CO3]
  • Growth rate slows and becomes equal to death rate, the no. of new cells is balanced
  • by the no. of cells dying, high cell density as a result nutrients become limited and
  • waste products accumulate, formation of endospores, release of toxins & stress
  • responses, write any two major points (2).
